sexual graphic, or extremist material."},{"line":61,"start":"00:04:02,270","end":"00:04:05,150","text":"Often children don't
search for this content."},{"line":62,"start":"00:04:05,480","end":"00:04:11,060","text":"It simply appears in recommendation
feeds, edited clips, or pop-up ads."},{"line":63,"start":"00:04:11,619","end":"00:04:15,250","text":"They may not fully understand
what they're seeing, but their"},{"line":64,"start":"00:04:15,250","end":"00:04:17,620","text":"emotions can be deeply affected."},{"line":65,"start":"00:04:18,250","end":"00:04:18,700","text":"Yeah."},{"line":66,"start":"00:04:18,700","end":"00:04:20,890","text":"That actually happened in our family."},{"line":67,"start":"00:04:21,250","end":"00:04:23,080","text":"That's exactly what scares me."},{"line":68,"start":"00:04:23,500","end":"00:04:26,169","text":"My daughter wasn't looking

but it absolutely wasn't."},{"line":75,"start":"00:04:46,145","end":"00:04:48,335","text":"Yeah, that's so scared."},{"line":76,"start":"00:04:48,875","end":"00:04:51,424","text":"The second type is contact risks."},{"line":77,"start":"00:04:51,784","end":"00:04:56,885","text":"This refers to children being approached

and gradually drawn into"},{"line":79,"start":"00:05:01,325","end":"00:05:03,335","text":"more private conversations."},{"line":80,"start":"00:05:03,905","end":"00:05:08,765","text":"At first, it may feel like friendly
interaction, but the goal can be to"},{"line":81,"start":"00:05:08,765","end":"00:05:14,494","text":"extract personal information such
as age school or contact details."},{"line":82,"start":"00:05:15,180","end":"00:05:19,590","text":"What makes this especially risky is

as a friend on a seemingly"},{"line":84,"start":"00:05:23,520","end":"00:05:25,050","text":"harmless game platform."},{"line":85,"start":"00:05:25,380","end":"00:05:27,630","text":"The other person claims
to be the same age."},{"line":86,"start":"00:05:27,840","end":"00:05:32,490","text":"They play together, chat casually,
and then the questions start."},{"line":87,"start":"00:05:32,970","end":"00:05:33,690","text":"Where do you live?"},{"line":88,"start":"00:05:33,690","end":"00:05:35,255","text":"Are your parents busy?"},{"line":89,"start":"00:05:35,940","end":"00:05:38,400","text":"It feels casual, but it's not."},{"line":90,"start":"00:05:39,060","end":"00:05:41,730","text":"The third category is conduct risks."},{"line":91,"start":"00:05:42,090","end":"00:05:45,240","text":"In group interactions,
children may imitate others."},{"line":92,"start":"00:05:45,390","end":"00:05:49,140","text":"Join in teasing or react
emotionally when provoked."},{"line":93,"start":"00:05:49,710","end":"00:05:54,540","text":"This can lead to harmful behavior,
sharing someone else's private photos,"},{"line":94,"start":"00:05:54,750","end":"00:06:00,090","text":"posting sarcastic comments, or becoming
targets of online bullying themselves."},{"line":95,"start":"00:06:00,690","end":"00:06:04,890","text":"These situations often come with
intense shame and emotional distress."},{"line":96,"start":"00:06:05,805","end":"00:06:10,035","text":"Yes, and what's difficult is that
children don't always realize"},{"line":97,"start":"00:06:10,035","end":"00:06:12,195","text":"they're causing harm in that moment."},{"line":98,"start":"00:06:12,645","end":"00:06:16,995","text":"My son was once added to a group chat
where some kids were joking around"},{"line":99,"start":"00:06:16,995","end":"00:06:22,185","text":"by sharing an unflattering photo of
a classmate with mocking captions."},{"line":100,"start":"00:06:22,455","end":"00:06:26,460","text":"He didn't post the photo, but he
did send a few laughing emojis."},{"line":101,"start":"00:06:27,675","end":"00:06:33,345","text":"Later when that classmate found out
and was deeply hurt, my son went"},{"line":102,"start":"00:06:33,345","end":"00:06:36,645","text":"silent for the entire day that night."},{"line":103,"start":"00:06:36,645","end":"00:06:37,305","text":"He told me."},{"line":104,"start":"00:06:37,785","end":"00:06:42,945","text":"I thought it was just a joke, but I'm
scared that picture will never disappear."},{"line":105,"start":"00:06:43,515","end":"00:06:47,565","text":"Yeah, and what's hard is that
the shame often comes after."},{"line":106,"start":"00:06:48,165","end":"00:06:50,985","text":"The last category is contract risk."},{"line":107,"start":"00:06:51,255","end":"00:06:55,875","text":"This includes things like clicking on
a free reward that secretly activates"},{"line":108,"start":"00:06:55,875","end":"00:07:01,155","text":"subscriptions, data permissions,
location tracking, or even payments."},{"line":109,"start":"00:07:01,725","end":"00:07:05,745","text":"Children usually don't understand
terms and conditions and the"},{"line":110,"start":"00:07:05,745","end":"00:07:08,145","text":"steps are often extremely quick."},{"line":111,"start":"00:07:08,790","end":"00:07:13,350","text":"Exactly, and often children don't
even realize a decision has been made."},{"line":112,"start":"00:07:13,830","end":"00:07:18,930","text":"A parent once told me their child clicked
try for free on a mini game ad. The"},{"line":113,"start":"00:07:18,930","end":"00:07:23,700","text":"pages flipped so fast the child didn't
even realize what they had agreed to."},{"line":114,"start":"00:07:24,554","end":"00:07:29,025","text":"A few days later, the family started
receiving strange promotional"},{"line":115,"start":"00:07:29,025","end":"00:07:33,104","text":"emails, and it turned out an
external account had been registered."},{"line":116,"start":"00:07:33,435","end":"00:07:37,905","text":"The child probably just clicked
agree without realizing it meant"},{"line":117,"start":"00:07:37,935","end":"00:07:40,364","text":"registration or authorization."},{"line":118,"start":"00:07:40,715","end":"00:07:44,525","text":"Yeah, that's why we say
restricting accounts doesn't"},{"line":119,"start":"00:07:44,525","end":"00:07:46,805","text":"automatically make children safe."},{"line":120,"start":"00:07:47,224","end":"00:07:51,635","text":"Risks usually don't come from having
an account, but from the small"},{"line":121,"start":"00:07:51,635","end":"00:07:56,075","text":"choices children make every day
across different digital situations."},{"line":122,"start":"00:07:56,745","end":"00:08:02,025","text":"So this is where parents really
matter At this age, children don't yet"},{"line":123,"start":"00:08:02,025","end":"00:08:06,855","text":"have the capacity to handle complex
online situations on their own."},{"line":124,"start":"00:08:07,275","end":"00:08:11,385","text":"They need a reliable adult,
someone who helps them recognize"},{"line":125,"start":"00:08:11,385","end":"00:08:13,005","text":"risks and offers support."},{"line":126,"start":"00:08:13,515","end":"00:08:14,475","text":"Absolutely."},{"line":127,"start":"00:08:14,590","end":"00:08:19,869","text":"Parents can't leave children alone to face
the entire digital world by themselves."},{"line":128,"start":"00:08:20,169","end":"00:08:21,640","text":"Especially at this stage."},{"line":129,"start":"00:08:21,789","end":"00:08:23,830","text":"Stepping in is part of the job."},{"line":130,"start":"00:08:24,400","end":"00:08:28,929","text":"In our next episode, we'll talk about
how parents can participate in their"},{"line":131,"start":"00:08:28,929","end":"00:08:31,450","text":"children's growth in the digital age."},{"line":132,"start":"00:08:31,809","end":"00:08:32,495","text":"See you next time."},{"line":133,"start":"00:08:33,330","end":"00:08:33,840","text":"See ya."}]

cartoon story, but it was full"},{"line":72,"start":"00:04:37,505","end":"00:04:39,215","text":"of violent fighting scenes."},{"line":73,"start":"00:04:39,575","end":"00:04:41,375","text":"It just appeared in her feed."},{"line":74,"start":"00:04:41,794","end":"00:04:45,544","text":"It looked child friendly,
but it absolutely wasn't."},{"line":75,"start":"00:04:46,145","end":"00:04:48,335","text":"Yeah, that's so scared."},{"line":76,"start":"00:04:48,875","end":"00:04:51,424","text":"The second type is contact risks."},{"line":77,"start":"00:04:51,784","end":"00:04:56,885","text":"This refers to children being approached
by strangers online through games."},{"line":78,"start":"00:04:57,155","end":"00:05:01,325","text":"Group chats or comment sections
and gradually drawn into"},{"line":79,"start":"00:05:01,325","end":"00:05:03,335","text":"more private conversations."},{"line":80,"start":"00:05:03,905","end":"00:05:08,765","text":"At first, it may feel like friendly
interaction, but the goal can be to"},{"line":81,"start":"00:05:08,765","end":"00:05:14,494","text":"extract personal information such
as age school or contact details."},{"line":82,"start":"00:05:15,180","end":"00:05:19,590","text":"What makes this especially risky is
how normal it looks at the beginning."},{"line":83,"start":"00:05:19,980","end":"00:05:23,520","text":"For example, a child gets added
as a friend on a seemingly"},{"line":84,"start":"00:05:23,520","end":"00:05:25,050","text":"harmless game platform."},{"line":85,"start":"00:05:25,380","end":"00:05:27,630","text":"The other person claims
to be the same age."},{"line":86,"start":"00:05:27,840","end":"00:05:32,490","text":"They play together, chat casually,
and then the questions start."},{"line":87,"start":"00:05:32,970","end":"00:05:33,690","text":"Where do you live?"},{"line":88,"start":"00:05:33,690","end":"00:05:35,255","text":"Are your parents busy?"},{"line":89,"start":"00:05:35,940","end":"00:05:38,400","text":"It feels casual, but it's not."},{"line":90,"start":"00:05:39,060","end":"00:05:41,730","text":"The third category is conduct risks."},{"line":91,"start":"00:05:42,090","end":"00:05:45,240","text":"In group interactions,
children may imitate others."},{"line":92,"start":"00:05:45,390","end":"00:05:49,140","text":"Join in teasing or react
emotionally when provoked."},{"line":93,"start":"00:05:49,710","end":"00:05:54,540","text":"This can lead to harmful behavior,
sharing someone else's private photos,"},{"line":94,"start":"00:05:54,750","end":"00:06:00,090","text":"posting sarcastic comments, or becoming
targets of online bullying themselves."},{"line":95,"start":"00:06:00,690","end":"00:06:04,890","text":"These situations often come with
intense shame and emotional distress."},{"line":96,"start":"00:06:05,805","end":"00:06:10,035","text":"Yes, and what's difficult is that
children don't always realize"},{"line":97,"start":"00:06:10,035","end":"00:06:12,195","text":"they're causing harm in that moment."},{"line":98,"start":"00:06:12,645","end":"00:06:16,995","text":"My son was once added to a group chat
where some kids were joking around"},{"line":99,"start":"00:06:16,995","end":"00:06:22,185","text":"by sharing an unflattering photo of
a classmate with mocking captions."},{"line":100,"start":"00:06:22,455","end":"00:06:26,460","text":"He didn't post the photo, but he
did send a few laughing emojis."},{"line":101,"start":"00:06:27,675","end":"00:06:33,345","text":"Later when that classmate found out
and was deeply hurt, my son went"},{"line":102,"start":"00:06:33,345","end":"00:06:36,645","text":"silent for the entire day that night."},{"line":103,"start":"00:06:36,645","end":"00:06:37,305","text":"He told me."},{"line":104,"start":"00:06:37,785","end":"00:06:42,945","text":"I thought it was just a joke, but I'm
scared that picture will never disappear."},{"line":105,"start":"00:06:43,515","end":"00:06:47,565","text":"Yeah, and what's hard is that
the shame often comes after."},{"line":106,"start":"00:06:48,165","end":"00:06:50,985","text":"The last category is contract risk."},{"line":107,"start":"00:06:51,255","end":"00:06:55,875","text":"This includes things like clicking on
a free reward that secretly activates"},{"line":108,"start":"00:06:55,875","end":"00:07:01,155","text":"subscriptions, data permissions,
location tracking, or even payments."},{"line":109,"start":"00:07:01,725","end":"00:07:05,745","text":"Children usually don't understand
terms and conditions and the"},{"line":110,"start":"00:07:05,745","end":"00:07:08,145","text":"steps are often extremely quick."},{"line":111,"start":"00:07:08,790","end":"00:07:13,350","text":"Exactly, and often children don't
even realize a decision has been made."},{"line":112,"start":"00:07:13,830","end":"00:07:18,930","text":"A parent once told me their child clicked
try for free on a mini game ad. The"},{"line":113,"start":"00:07:18,930","end":"00:07:23,700","text":"pages flipped so fast the child didn't
even realize what they had agreed to."},{"line":114,"start":"00:07:24,554","end":"00:07:29,025","text":"A few days later, the family started
receiving strange promotional"},{"line":115,"start":"00:07:29,025","end":"00:07:33,104","text":"emails, and it turned out an
external account had been registered."},{"line":116,"start":"00:07:33,435","end":"00:07:37,905","text":"The child probably just clicked
agree without realizing it meant"},{"line":117,"start":"00:07:37,935","end":"00:07:40,364","text":"registration or authorization."},{"line":118,"start":"00:07:40,715","end":"00:07:44,525","text":"Yeah, that's why we say
restricting accounts doesn't"},{"line":119,"start":"00:07:44,525","end":"00:07:46,805","text":"automatically make children safe."},{"line":120,"start":"00:07:47,224","end":"00:07:51,635","text":"Risks usually don't come from having
an account, but from the small"},{"line":121,"start":"00:07:51,635","end":"00:07:56,075","text":"choices children make every day
across different digital situations."},{"line":122,"start":"00:07:56,745","end":"00:08:02,025","text":"So this is where parents really
matter At this age, children don't yet"},{"line":123,"start":"00:08:02,025","end":"00:08:06,855","text":"have the capacity to handle complex
online situations on their own."},{"line":124,"start":"00:08:07,275","end":"00:08:11,385","text":"They need a reliable adult,
someone who helps them recognize"},{"line":125,"start":"00:08:11,385","end":"00:08:13,005","text":"risks and offers support."},{"line":126,"start":"00:08:13,515","end":"00:08:14,475","text":"Absolutely."},{"line":127,"start":"00:08:14,590","end":"00:08:19,869","text":"Parents can't leave children alone to face
the entire digital world by themselves."},{"line":128,"start":"00:08:20,169","end":"00:08:21,640","text":"Especially at this stage."},{"line":129,"start":"00:08:21,789","end":"00:08:23,830","text":"Stepping in is part of the job."},{"line":130,"start":"00:08:24,400","end":"00:08:28,929","text":"In our next episode, we'll talk about
how parents can participate in their"},{"line":131,"start":"00:08:28,929","end":"00:08:31,450","text":"children's growth in the digital age."},{"line":132,"start":"00:08:31,809","end":"00:08:32,495","text":"See you next time."},{"line":133,"start":"00:08:33,330","end":"00:08:33,840","text":"See ya."}]

title: The Apps Children Use and the Hidden Risks
description: This episode looks at the apps children use every day, including social media, games, messaging, and learning tools. It explains how common features like feeds, chats, search, and permissions can create hidden risks, and why parents need to understand them.
transcript_text: [{"line":1,"start":"00:00:00,000","end":"00:00:15,000","text":"Welcome to 8 Minutes of Digital Parenting, I'm Emily."},{"line":2,"start":"00:00:15,000","end":"00:00:17,000","text":"Hi everyone, I'm Jack."},{"line":3,"start":"00:00:17,000","end":"00:00:23,000","text":"In our last episode, which added about how parents can support their kids in this ever-changing"},{"line":4,"start":"00:00:23,000","end":"00:00:29,000","text":"digital world, we explored the differences between supportive parenting and more controlling"},{"line":5,"start":"00:00:29,000","end":"00:00:34,600","text":"approaches, and I think it's fair to say we lean towards a more supportive style, which"},{"line":6,"start":"00:00:34,600","end":"00:00:38,800","text":"is really about going on the journey with our kids."},{"line":7,"start":"00:00:38,800","end":"00:00:44,000","text":"That's right, and we broke this idea down into three very practical keys last time."},{"line":8,"start":"00:00:44,000","end":"00:00:48,500","text":"First, talking with kids before problems come up, rather than interrogating them after"},{"line":9,"start":"00:00:48,500","end":"00:00:50,500","text":"something's already gone wrong."},{"line":10,"start":"00:00:50,500","end":"00:00:55,700","text":"Second, explain why rules exist instead of just giving orders."},{"line":11,"start":"00:00:55,700","end":"00:01:01,200","text":"And third, allowing kids to make mistakes, then facing them together and figuring things"},{"line":12,"start":"00:01:01,200","end":"00:01:02,800","text":"out as a team."},{"line":13,"start":"00:01:02,800","end":"00:01:06,800","text":"And I think the big message there was that kids shouldn't feel like they're dealing"},{"line":14,"start":"00:01:06,800","end":"00:01:09,700","text":"with the online world all on their own."},{"line":15,"start":"00:01:09,700","end":"00:01:14,700","text":"There's someone beside them listening and helping them work out the next step."},{"line":16,"start":"00:01:14,700","end":"00:01:19,200","text":"I guess though, from a parent's point of view, this is where it can get tricky."},{"line":17,"start":"00:01:19,200","end":"00:01:23,800","text":"A lot of parents actually want to have these conversations, they just don't always know"},{"line":18,"start":"00:01:23,800","end":"00:01:25,300","text":"where to start."},{"line":19,"start":"00:01:25,300","end":"00:01:31,400","text":"The online world moves so fast, new platforms, new features, it's hard to keep up."},{"line":20,"start":"00:01:31,400","end":"00:01:36,400","text":"And sometimes it feels like kids are operating in a completely different space."},{"line":21,"start":"00:01:36,400","end":"00:01:41,200","text":"And something that's changed recently, especially here in Australia, is that there are now stricter"},{"line":22,"start":"00:01:41,200","end":"00:01:45,000","text":"rules around children signing up for some social media platforms."},{"line":23,"start":"00:01:45,000","end":"00:01:50,800","text":"Yeah, and a lot of parents might think, well, if my child can't sign up, there may be these"},{"line":24,"start":"00:01:50,800","end":"00:01:53,000","text":"risks don't really apply anymore."},{"line":25,"start":"00:01:53,300","end":"00:01:55,600","text":"But that's not really what's happening, is it?"},{"line":26,"start":"00:01:55,600","end":"00:01:56,900","text":"Not quite."},{"line":27,"start":"00:01:56,900","end":"00:02:02,400","text":"Kids are still seeing the same kind of content, still interacting in similar ways."},{"line":28,"start":"00:02:02,400","end":"00:02:05,000","text":"It's just happening through different paths."},{"line":29,"start":"00:02:05,000","end":"00:02:06,200","text":"Exactly."},{"line":30,"start":"00:02:06,200","end":"00:02:11,200","text":"They might be watching videos on someone else's device, seeing things shared in group chats"},{"line":31,"start":"00:02:11,200","end":"00:02:14,400","text":"or coming across content through games or search tools."},{"line":32,"start":"00:02:14,400","end":"00:02:20,100","text":"So maybe instead of asking what apps are kids using, it's more helpful to ask,"},{"line":33,"start":"00:02:20,100","end":"00:02:24,100","text":"how are kids actually getting into these online spaces?"},{"line":34,"start":"00:02:24,100","end":"00:02:26,900","text":"Yeah, that's a much better way to think about it."},{"line":35,"start":"00:02:26,900","end":"00:02:29,300","text":"Take short videos, for example."},{"line":36,"start":"00:02:29,300","end":"00:02:34,000","text":"Even if a child doesn't have an account on TikTok or Instagram, they're still watching"},{"line":37,"start":"00:02:34,000","end":"00:02:35,700","text":"that kind of content."},{"line":38,"start":"00:02:35,700","end":"00:02:40,100","text":"It might be on a parent's phone, through a browser, or just something a friend shows"},{"line":39,"start":"00:02:40,100","end":"00:02:40,900","text":"them."},{"line":40,"start":"00:02:40,900","end":"00:02:46,900","text":"And from their point of view, it just feels like watching videos, nothing complicated."},{"line":41,"start":"00:02:46,900","end":"00:02:49,900","text":"But behind that, there's still a lot going on."},{"line":42,"start":"00:02:49,900","end":"00:02:54,400","text":"Recommendations, trends, comments, people interacting."},{"line":43,"start":"00:02:54,400","end":"00:02:55,100","text":"Yeah."},{"line":44,"start":"00:02:55,100","end":"00:03:00,400","text":"And sometimes kids don't realize how much information can be shared through small things."},{"line":45,"start":"00:03:00,400","end":"00:03:04,500","text":"Like what's in the background of a video or where something was filmed?"},{"line":46,"start":"00:03:04,500","end":"00:03:06,700","text":"Or even who ends up seeing it?"},{"line":47,"start":"00:03:06,700","end":"00:03:09,900","text":"And this is where a lot of parents are surprised."},{"line":48,"start":"00:03:09,900","end":"00:03:12,800","text":"The second category is gaming platforms."},{"line":49,"start":"00:03:12,800","end":"00:03:18,800","text":"A lot of parents hear games and think it's just about screen time or distraction."},{"line":50,"start":"00:03:18,800","end":"00:03:24,300","text":"But for many kids today, games are also places where they interact with others."},{"line":51,"start":"00:03:24,300","end":"00:03:29,800","text":"And another thing parents often miss is how these game systems work behind the scenes."},{"line":52,"start":"00:03:29,800","end":"00:03:35,500","text":"Things like virtual coins, skins, or items can be really appealing."},{"line":53,"start":"00:03:35,500","end":"00:03:40,100","text":"But kids don't always understand what's really going on behind it or what they're agreeing"},{"line":54,"start":"00:03:40,100","end":"00:03:41,800","text":"to when they click through."},{"line":55,"start":"00:03:41,800","end":"00:03:43,300","text":"That's so true, Emily."},{"line":56,"start":"00:03:43,300","end":"00:03:47,800","text":"And that actually brings us to our third category, messaging platforms."},{"line":57,"start":"00:03:47,800","end":"00:03:50,300","text":"Some parents think it's just chatting."},{"line":58,"start":"00:03:50,300","end":"00:03:56,300","text":"But for kids, these spaces can become quite private and sometimes very active."},{"line":59,"start":"00:03:56,300","end":"00:03:57,000","text":"Yeah."},{"line":60,"start":"00:03:57,000","end":"00:04:03,600","text":"Apps like WhatsApp, Discord, and Telegram often start off as simple ways to talk to classmates"},{"line":61,"start":"00:04:03,600","end":"00:04:05,600","text":"for homework or games."},{"line":62,"start":"00:04:05,600","end":"00:04:10,600","text":"But over time, these conversations can grow and kids might end up chatting with people"},{"line":63,"start":"00:04:10,600","end":"00:04:12,600","text":"that don't really know very well."},{"line":64,"start":"00:04:12,600","end":"00:04:17,100","text":"And because it feels so normal, kids don't always notice when a conversation starts to"},{"line":65,"start":"00:04:17,100","end":"00:04:19,600","text":"shift in a direction that's uncomfortable."},{"line":66,"start":"00:04:19,600","end":"00:04:20,100","text":"Yeah."},{"line":67,"start":"00:04:20,100","end":"00:04:25,100","text":"But the tricky part is a lot of this happens in spaces adults don't really see."},{"line":68,"start":"00:04:25,100","end":"00:04:28,800","text":"So day to day, it's not obvious what's really going on."},{"line":69,"start":"00:04:28,800","end":"00:04:29,300","text":"All right."},{"line":70,"start":"00:04:29,300","end":"00:04:32,500","text":"The fourth category is tools and learning platforms."},{"line":71,"start":"00:04:32,500","end":"00:04:35,200","text":"These often sound like the safest place."},{"line":72,"start":"00:04:35,200","end":"00:04:37,200","text":"I mean, they're learning, right?"},{"line":73,"start":"00:04:37,200","end":"00:04:43,400","text":"Yeah, things like search engines, online learning platforms, homework apps, cloud documents,"},{"line":74,"start":"00:04:43,400","end":"00:04:45,200","text":"and even AI tools."},{"line":75,"start":"00:04:45,200","end":"00:04:48,200","text":"These are all familiar to our children."},{"line":76,"start":"00:04:48,200","end":"00:04:52,200","text":"And the thing is, a lot of these don't even require an account to use."},{"line":77,"start":"00:04:52,200","end":"00:04:54,400","text":"Kids can just jump straight in."},{"line":78,"start":"00:04:54,400","end":"00:04:57,800","text":"They use them for research, assignments, and presentations."},{"line":79,"start":"00:04:57,800","end":"00:05:03,800","text":"But they also click on recommended links, related content, or built-in interactive features"},{"line":80,"start":"00:05:03,800","end":"00:05:05,800","text":"without thinking too much about it."},{"line":81,"start":"00:05:05,800","end":"00:05:10,000","text":"And another thing that some parents have started noticing is that children don't always"},{"line":82,"start":"00:05:10,000","end":"00:05:12,200","text":"open apps directly anymore."},{"line":83,"start":"00:05:12,200","end":"00:05:17,400","text":"Sometimes they access things through voice assistants like Siri or Hey Google."},{"line":84,"start":"00:05:17,400","end":"00:05:23,000","text":"A child might just ask a question out loud and suddenly a video starts or a website pops up."},{"line":85,"start":"00:05:23,000","end":"00:05:24,000","text":"Agreed."},{"line":86,"start":"00:05:24,000","end":"00:05:29,200","text":"And the tricky part is children often don't really know where that content is coming from"},{"line":87,"start":"00:05:29,200","end":"00:05:31,300","text":"or whether it's filtered for their age."},{"line":88,"start":"00:05:31,300","end":"00:05:34,900","text":"To them, it just feels like they're asking a simple question."},{"line":89,"start":"00:05:34,900","end":"00:05:36,800","text":"Yeah, that's a really good point."},{"line":90,"start":"00:05:36,800","end":"00:05:39,500","text":"These tools are designed to be convenient."},{"line":91,"start":"00:05:39,500","end":"00:05:45,200","text":"But that also means they can skip the usual steps where someone might check what's being opened."},{"line":92,"start":"00:05:45,200","end":"00:05:49,700","text":"So again, it shows that risks don't just come from the apps themselves,"},{"line":93,"start":"00:05:49,700","end":"00:05:53,100","text":"but also from how kids access content."},{"line":94,"start":"00:05:53,100","end":"00:05:58,000","text":"And another issue is that these platforms aren't really built just for children."},{"line":95,"start":"00:05:58,000","end":"00:06:03,000","text":"Content is often open to everyone, and search results or recommendations don't always"},{"line":96,"start":"00:06:03,000","end":"00:06:05,900","text":"filter out things that aren't age appropriate."},{"line":97,"start":"00:06:05,900","end":"00:06:11,100","text":"So a child might search for something innocent, scroll a little, and suddenly see something"},{"line":98,"start":"00:06:11,100","end":"00:06:13,500","text":"that's not suitable for their age."},{"line":99,"start":"00:06:13,500","end":"00:06:17,800","text":"Some platforms also have spaces where people share opinions."},{"line":100,"start":"00:06:17,800","end":"00:06:23,700","text":"And kids might come across strong, emotional, or even aggressive content without knowing"},{"line":101,"start":"00:06:23,700","end":"00:06:25,800","text":"how to make sense of it."},{"line":102,"start":"00:06:25,800","end":"00:06:29,700","text":"Another thing people often overlook is data and privacy."},{"line":103,"start":"00:06:29,700","end":"00:06:35,700","text":"Any tools require logins, permissions, or uploading personal information."},{"line":104,"start":"00:06:35,700","end":"00:06:41,000","text":"Kids often just click Agree, so they can keep going without really understanding what they're"},{"line":105,"start":"00:06:41,000","end":"00:06:43,200","text":"allowing or sharing."},{"line":106,"start":"00:06:43,200","end":"00:06:48,400","text":"So across these four categories, the risks are often varied, but not always obvious."},{"line":107,"start":"00:06:48,400","end":"00:06:49,700","text":"Exactly."},{"line":108,"start":"00:06:49,700","end":"00:06:52,600","text":"And those risks don't just come from the apps themselves."},{"line":109,"start":"00:06:52,600","end":"00:06:58,300","text":"They also come from how children access content and how they interact with different features."},{"line":110,"start":"00:06:58,300","end":"00:07:03,700","text":"So what we need to do isn't and really can't be, is to try and control everything kids"},{"line":111,"start":"00:07:03,700","end":"00:07:04,800","text":"do online."},{"line":112,"start":"00:07:04,800","end":"00:07:10,100","text":"It's more about slowly getting familiar with how these tools work and noticing the kinds"},{"line":113,"start":"00:07:10,100","end":"00:07:12,800","text":"of risks that might come along the way."},{"line":114,"start":"00:07:12,800","end":"00:07:16,800","text":"Yeah, one helpful approach is to involve children in these conversations."},{"line":115,"start":"00:07:16,800","end":"00:07:22,400","text":"You might ask things like, what would you do if questions and talk through different"},{"line":116,"start":"00:07:22,400","end":"00:07:24,600","text":"situations together?"},{"line":117,"start":"00:07:24,600","end":"00:07:28,800","text":"When kids know they can speak up without getting into trouble or losing access straight"},{"line":118,"start":"00:07:28,800","end":"00:07:32,300","text":"away, they're much more likely to come to you early."},{"line":119,"start":"00:07:32,300","end":"00:07:36,900","text":"What really makes a big difference is helping kids notice what's going on and thinking about"},{"line":120,"start":"00:07:36,900","end":"00:07:38,800","text":"the choices they're making."},{"line":121,"start":"00:07:38,800","end":"00:07:44,340","text":"We can't control everything, but we can stay available, keep the conversation open, and"},{"line":122,"start":"00:07:44,340","end":"00:07:48,400","text":"remind them that they can come to us anytime something feels off."},{"line":123,"start":"00:07:48,400","end":"00:07:54,100","text":"In the next episode, we'll talk about practical tools parents can use, like screen time controls,"},{"line":124,"start":"00:07:54,100","end":"00:08:00,100","text":"usage limits, content filters, and privacy settings to reduce risks before they happen."},{"line":125,"start":"00:08:00,100","end":"00:08:02,100","text":"Alright, we'll see you next time."},{"line":126,"start":"00:08:02,100","end":"00:08:03,100","text":"Bye everyone!"}]

title: The Tools Parents Can Use in Advance
description: This episode introduces tools parents can use before problems happen, such as checking screen-use patterns, setting time limits, filtering content, and managing privacy settings. It shows how these tools can support awareness, conversation, and early help-seeking.
transcript_text: [{"line":1,"start":"00:00:00,000","end":"00:00:15,000","text":"Welcome to 8 Minutes of Digital Parenting. I'm Emily."},{"line":2,"start":"00:00:15,000","end":"00:00:17,000","text":"Hi, I'm Jack."},{"line":3,"start":"00:00:17,000","end":"00:00:21,600","text":"In the last episode, we spent quite a bit of time looking at the four main types of apps"},{"line":4,"start":"00:00:21,600","end":"00:00:26,120","text":"kids use every day, and the kinds of risks that can come with them."},{"line":5,"start":"00:00:26,120","end":"00:00:30,400","text":"We said the first group is short video and social platforms."},{"line":6,"start":"00:00:30,400","end":"00:00:34,520","text":"Kids scroll through recommended videos and watch live streams."},{"line":7,"start":"00:00:34,520","end":"00:00:39,360","text":"It often looks like harmless entertainment, but along the way, they might come across"},{"line":8,"start":"00:00:39,360","end":"00:00:43,840","text":"unsuitable content or interact with people they don't really know."},{"line":9,"start":"00:00:43,840","end":"00:00:47,280","text":"Yeah, the second group is gaming platforms."},{"line":10,"start":"00:00:47,280","end":"00:00:53,200","text":"With features like voice chat, team play and in-game purchases, kids are often interacting"},{"line":11,"start":"00:00:53,240","end":"00:00:59,280","text":"with others in real time, and sometimes sharing small bits of information without really thinking"},{"line":12,"start":"00:00:59,280","end":"00:01:00,360","text":"about it."},{"line":13,"start":"00:01:00,360","end":"00:01:05,440","text":"The third group is messaging apps. That's where kids spend a lot of time talking and"},{"line":14,"start":"00:01:05,440","end":"00:01:11,280","text":"it can feel quite private. Some conversations might become uncomfortable, but kids don't"},{"line":15,"start":"00:01:11,280","end":"00:01:15,280","text":"always find it easy to share what's happening with their parents."},{"line":16,"start":"00:01:15,280","end":"00:01:21,680","text":"And the fourth group is utility and learning apps. Many parents assume these are the safest,"},{"line":17,"start":"00:01:21,680","end":"00:01:23,640","text":"but that's not always true."},{"line":18,"start":"00:01:23,640","end":"00:01:30,040","text":"For example, apps like Padlet or Canva for education sometimes allow sharing or collaboration"},{"line":19,"start":"00:01:30,040","end":"00:01:33,360","text":"outside the classroom, depending on the settings."},{"line":20,"start":"00:01:33,360","end":"00:01:39,040","text":"And even in these apps, search results, comments or recommendations aren't always filtered"},{"line":21,"start":"00:01:39,040","end":"00:01:42,840","text":"for kids, and data and privacy are easy to miss."},{"line":22,"start":"00:01:42,840","end":"00:01:46,920","text":"Yeah, that's something people are often quite surprised by."},{"line":23,"start":"00:01:46,920","end":"00:01:51,640","text":"Absolutely. But after hearing all that, a lot of parents end up asking the same questions"},{"line":24,"start":"00:01:52,640","end":"00:01:58,600","text":"There are so many risks, and we can't be watching our kids all the time. So what can"},{"line":25,"start":"00:01:58,600","end":"00:02:01,040","text":"we do to prevent something from going wrong?"},{"line":26,"start":"00:02:01,040","end":"00:02:04,240","text":"Yeah, that's the big one. Where do we start?"},{"line":27,"start":"00:02:04,240","end":"00:02:10,080","text":"That's what today's episode is about. Looking at a few practical, low pressure ways parents"},{"line":28,"start":"00:02:10,080","end":"00:02:15,480","text":"can stay aware of what's going on without having to constantly watch over everything."},{"line":29,"start":"00:02:15,480","end":"00:02:21,440","text":"Cool. Let's start with something common, screen time. Most devices already show parents"},{"line":30,"start":"00:02:21,680","end":"00:02:27,200","text":"how much time kids spend on apps each day. You can see which apps they use most and how"},{"line":31,"start":"00:02:27,200","end":"00:02:31,000","text":"things change over time. It's pretty straightforward."},{"line":32,"start":"00:02:31,000","end":"00:02:36,280","text":"Exactly. And those numbers don't automatically mean something is wrong, but they can give"},{"line":33,"start":"00:02:36,280","end":"00:02:41,720","text":"you little clues about what your child is interested in or how they're doing. If time"},{"line":34,"start":"00:02:41,720","end":"00:02:48,000","text":"on a certain app suddenly goes up, it might reflect a change in mood, habits or interests."},{"line":35,"start":"00:02:48,000","end":"00:02:51,480","text":"But noticing that can open up a really natural conversation."},{"line":36,"start":"00:02:51,480","end":"00:02:55,280","text":"Yeah, and you don't have to check these numbers every day either."},{"line":37,"start":"00:02:55,280","end":"00:02:59,640","text":"Not at all. If it's something you've already agreed on as a family, you can check in now"},{"line":38,"start":"00:02:59,640","end":"00:03:04,920","text":"and then. If not, it's better to do it together with your child so it feels more like a shared"},{"line":39,"start":"00:03:04,920","end":"00:03:10,880","text":"activity. You can use it as a starting point for a conversation like, hey, I've noticed"},{"line":40,"start":"00:03:10,880","end":"00:03:15,760","text":"you've been on this a bit more lately. What are you liking about it? Or what have you"},{"line":41,"start":"00:03:15,760","end":"00:03:20,760","text":"been watching? Just really simple, easy questions. When kids"},{"line":42,"start":"00:03:20,760","end":"00:03:25,800","text":"feel like you're just curious, not judging them, they're way more likely to open up and"},{"line":43,"start":"00:03:25,800","end":"00:03:32,760","text":"be a bit more interested in your advice too. The second tool is time limits. Many devices"},{"line":44,"start":"00:03:32,760","end":"00:03:39,040","text":"and parental control apps already have this built in. iPhones have screen time, Android"},{"line":45,"start":"00:03:39,040","end":"00:03:44,840","text":"has digital well-being and tools like Family Link or Alpact."},{"line":46,"start":"00:03:44,840","end":"00:03:49,880","text":"These controls let parents set daily limits for certain apps. When the time is up, the"},{"line":47,"start":"00:03:49,880","end":"00:03:54,480","text":"app might give a reminder or just lock. You've probably seen this already."},{"line":48,"start":"00:03:54,480","end":"00:03:59,800","text":"Yeah, absolutely. And this works well as a way to get ahead of things. If you notice"},{"line":49,"start":"00:03:59,800","end":"00:04:04,240","text":"one app is taking up a lot of time, you can just sit down together and chat about it"},{"line":50,"start":"00:04:04,240","end":"00:04:06,960","text":"and figure out a limit that feels reasonable."},{"line":51,"start":"00:04:06,960","end":"00:04:11,400","text":"So it doesn't feel like you're setting rules. It feels more like you're working it"},{"line":52,"start":"00:04:11,400","end":"00:04:18,080","text":"out together. Exactly. Putting boundaries in early before it turns into a conflict usually"},{"line":53,"start":"00:04:18,080","end":"00:04:24,160","text":"helps build mutual respect and cooperation. In time limits can also tell you something."},{"line":54,"start":"00:04:24,160","end":"00:04:28,800","text":"If a child keeps hitting the time limit at the same time each day or really gets upset"},{"line":55,"start":"00:04:28,800","end":"00:04:32,640","text":"when it locks, that's usually a sign that something's going on."},{"line":56,"start":"00:04:32,640","end":"00:04:38,080","text":"Yeah, you might say something like, hey, I've noticed it's really hard for you to stop"},{"line":57,"start":"00:04:38,080","end":"00:04:43,320","text":"when this locks. What's going on? Are you just really into it right now or is something"},{"line":58,"start":"00:04:43,320","end":"00:04:49,160","text":"else going on? Sometimes that conversation matters more than adjusting the limit itself."},{"line":59,"start":"00:04:49,160","end":"00:04:54,600","text":"The third tool is content filtering. Many devices and parental control apps let you"},{"line":60,"start":"00:04:54,600","end":"00:05:00,560","text":"turn on things like safe search or age limits. These settings can help reduce the chances"},{"line":61,"start":"00:05:00,640","end":"00:05:06,160","text":"of kids running into stuff that's too violent, too sexual or a bit scary."},{"line":62,"start":"00:05:06,160","end":"00:05:11,520","text":"And honestly, it's easier to set up than most people think. Yeah, exactly. These tools are"},{"line":63,"start":"00:05:11,520","end":"00:05:16,680","text":"about cutting down on stuff just popping up out of nowhere. These days, kids don't always"},{"line":64,"start":"00:05:16,680","end":"00:05:22,480","text":"go looking for content. It often just gets pushed to them. So filters act like a layer"},{"line":65,"start":"00:05:22,480","end":"00:05:25,720","text":"in the background catching some of that stuff early."},{"line":66,"start":"00:05:25,720","end":"00:05:30,280","text":"If you're not sure how to set it up, you can always head to the eSafety website. They've"},{"line":67,"start":"00:05:30,280","end":"00:05:33,040","text":"got step-by-step guides to walk you through it."},{"line":68,"start":"00:05:33,040","end":"00:05:38,120","text":"It's also a nice chance to have a quick, low-key chat. You can explain that these settings"},{"line":69,"start":"00:05:38,120","end":"00:05:43,240","text":"are there to make things feel a bit safer and more suitable, not just because they've"},{"line":70,"start":"00:05:43,240","end":"00:05:49,320","text":"done something wrong. For example, you might say something like, I turned this on. So"},{"line":71,"start":"00:05:49,320","end":"00:05:53,720","text":"what shows up is a bit more suitable for you. And then just add, if anything ever feels"},{"line":72,"start":"00:05:53,720","end":"00:05:57,080","text":"a bit weird or uncomfortable, just tell me, yeah?"},{"line":73,"start":"00:05:57,080","end":"00:06:01,960","text":"That kind of reassurance really helps. And over time, that helps kids start to figure"},{"line":74,"start":"00:06:01,960","end":"00:06:06,920","text":"out things themselves. Interesting, Jack. What's the last tool?"},{"line":75,"start":"00:06:06,920","end":"00:06:12,920","text":"The last tool is privacy and permission management. A lot of apps ask for access to things like"},{"line":76,"start":"00:06:12,920","end":"00:06:19,560","text":"your photos, microphone, location or contacts. If no one explains it, kids can just tap"},{"line":77,"start":"00:06:19,560","end":"00:06:25,120","text":"allow without thinking it through. Yeah, exactly. From a prevention point of view,"},{"line":78,"start":"00:06:25,120","end":"00:06:30,680","text":"this is actually one of the easiest things to adjust, like turning off location. That"},{"line":79,"start":"00:06:30,680","end":"00:06:35,640","text":"way it's not sharing where they are. Or limiting who can message them helps cut down random"},{"line":80,"start":"00:06:35,640","end":"00:06:41,480","text":"contact. You don't have to change everything at once. Just tweak things bit by bit. It's"},{"line":81,"start":"00:06:41,480","end":"00:06:47,080","text":"also a good idea to occasionally check which apps have accessed the things like location,"},{"line":82,"start":"00:06:47,080","end":"00:06:52,080","text":"camera or personal data. Yeah, and you can keep it really casual."},{"line":83,"start":"00:06:52,080","end":"00:06:56,240","text":"Like, I noticed some of the settings on this app are on by default. Want to have a quick"},{"line":84,"start":"00:06:56,240","end":"00:07:01,720","text":"look at them together? Or, shall we check what apps are using your location? It's about"},{"line":85,"start":"00:07:01,720","end":"00:07:06,960","text":"doing it with them, not checking up on them. That way, kids start to see that this is just"},{"line":86,"start":"00:07:06,960","end":"00:07:11,640","text":"part of looking after themselves. So yeah, in the end, it's not about doing"},{"line":87,"start":"00:07:11,640","end":"00:07:17,200","text":"everything perfectly. It's more about knowing that these options are there and using what"},{"line":88,"start":"00:07:17,200","end":"00:07:23,280","text":"works best for your family. Even a few small changes can make things a bit safer before"},{"line":89,"start":"00:07:23,280","end":"00:07:28,800","text":"problems come up. Exactly, Jack. In the next episode, we'll talk about something a bit"},{"line":90,"start":"00:07:28,800","end":"00:07:35,760","text":"newer, like AI. Big topic, but we'll keep it simple and practical. See you next time."},{"line":91,"start":"00:07:35,760","end":"00:07:36,440","text":"Bye, everyone."}]

title: Generative AI and Hidden Risks
description: This episode explores hidden risks of generative AI, including inaccurate answers, realistic fake images, and children relying on AI for emotional support. It encourages parents to help children treat AI as a tool, check information, and seek real human support.
transcript_text: [{"line":1,"start":"00:00:00,000","end":"00:00:15,000","text":"Welcome to 8 Minutes of Digital Parenting. I'm Emily."},{"line":2,"start":"00:00:15,000","end":"00:00:17,000","text":"Hi, I'm Jack."},{"line":3,"start":"00:00:17,000","end":"00:00:21,000","text":"Last time we talked about tools parents can set up in advance,"},{"line":4,"start":"00:00:21,000","end":"00:00:27,000","text":"like screen use, review, time limits, content filters and privacy settings."},{"line":5,"start":"00:00:27,000","end":"00:00:33,000","text":"They're all about getting ahead of things, reducing risks, protecting privacy and noticing problems early."},{"line":6,"start":"00:00:33,000","end":"00:00:35,000","text":"And all of this matters."},{"line":7,"start":"00:00:35,000","end":"00:00:40,000","text":"But there is also another technology tool that parents are increasingly seeking support for."},{"line":8,"start":"00:00:40,000","end":"00:00:48,000","text":"Generative AI, writing tools, image generators, chatbots and study helpers."},{"line":9,"start":"00:00:48,000","end":"00:00:52,000","text":"For many young teens, it feels fast, easy and useful."},{"line":10,"start":"00:00:52,000","end":"00:00:56,000","text":"At first glance, AI can seem very helpful."},{"line":11,"start":"00:00:56,000","end":"00:01:03,000","text":"It can help children search for information, get ideas, draft homework or create images."},{"line":12,"start":"00:01:03,000","end":"00:01:09,000","text":"But it may also affect how they learn and their capacity to evaluate information."},{"line":13,"start":"00:01:09,000","end":"00:01:14,000","text":"Children may also overshare personal information when using these tools"},{"line":14,"start":"00:01:14,000","end":"00:01:17,000","text":"and some of these risks can be easy to miss."},{"line":15,"start":"00:01:17,000","end":"00:01:22,000","text":"Yeah, a lot of parents are thinking, wait, what am I supposed to do about this?"},{"line":16,"start":"00:01:22,000","end":"00:01:29,000","text":"Exactly. So today we'll slow it down and look at what is changing for children in years 7-9"},{"line":17,"start":"00:01:29,000","end":"00:01:33,000","text":"and all the hidden risks parents can help them notice."},{"line":18,"start":"00:01:33,000","end":"00:01:37,000","text":"The first risk is what people sometimes call pseudo-knowledge,"},{"line":19,"start":"00:01:37,000","end":"00:01:42,000","text":"information that sounds confident but may not be accurate."},{"line":20,"start":"00:01:42,000","end":"00:01:48,000","text":"AI can sound very sure. It's smooth, it flows and it can even say things like"},{"line":21,"start":"00:01:48,000","end":"00:01:51,000","text":"according to a study or expert say."},{"line":22,"start":"00:01:51,000","end":"00:01:55,000","text":"But confident wording is not the same as reliable evidence."},{"line":23,"start":"00:01:55,000","end":"00:02:01,000","text":"That's a problem. It can feel like a proper answer so a child may accept it without checking."},{"line":24,"start":"00:02:01,000","end":"00:02:07,000","text":"Sometimes the study doesn't exist or it exists but does not actually say what the AI report says."},{"line":25,"start":"00:02:07,000","end":"00:02:13,000","text":"Sometimes it's even harder to notice because AI pulls together bits of information that are partly right"},{"line":26,"start":"00:02:13,000","end":"00:02:18,000","text":"and turns them into an answer that sounds fine but could be misleading."},{"line":27,"start":"00:02:18,000","end":"00:02:22,000","text":"Yes, so the issue is not just whether children use AI,"},{"line":28,"start":"00:02:22,000","end":"00:02:27,000","text":"it's whether they learn to check the accuracy of AI-generated responses."},{"line":29,"start":"00:02:27,000","end":"00:02:31,000","text":"Children often won't see a warning sign. They may think this makes sense"},{"line":30,"start":"00:02:31,000","end":"00:02:35,000","text":"and copy it into homework or a presentation as if it were verified knowledge."},{"line":31,"start":"00:02:36,000","end":"00:02:44,000","text":"That is why parents can focus on a simple habit, pause, check and compare the answer to another trusted source."},{"line":32,"start":"00:02:44,000","end":"00:02:47,000","text":"So does this mean children should not use AI at all?"},{"line":33,"start":"00:02:47,000","end":"00:02:53,000","text":"No, the goal is not to ban AI. It is to help children use it with judgment."},{"line":34,"start":"00:02:53,000","end":"00:02:57,000","text":"What matters is helping them avoid trusting it straight away."},{"line":35,"start":"00:02:57,000","end":"00:03:02,000","text":"A short pause before copying, sharing or believing an answer can make a big difference."},{"line":36,"start":"00:03:02,000","end":"00:03:05,000","text":"That's right. Parents can ask simple questions."},{"line":37,"start":"00:03:05,000","end":"00:03:13,000","text":"Like, does that match what you learned at school? Can we find the source or what information did you give the AI to get that answer?"},{"line":38,"start":"00:03:13,000","end":"00:03:20,000","text":"Over time, children start to learn that even if something sounds certain, they still need to check it"},{"line":39,"start":"00:03:20,000","end":"00:03:25,000","text":"and avoid entering personal details that they would not normally share publicly."},{"line":40,"start":"00:03:26,000","end":"00:03:34,000","text":"The second risk is AI-generated images. These can look so real that children may not know what is genuine and what is artificial."},{"line":41,"start":"00:03:34,000","end":"00:03:37,000","text":"And it's no longer about just editing a photo."},{"line":42,"start":"00:03:37,000","end":"00:03:44,000","text":"AI can create whole images from scratch, faces, backgrounds, events and scenes that never happened."},{"line":43,"start":"00:03:44,000","end":"00:03:49,000","text":"It can also place a real person's face into a situation that never happened."},{"line":44,"start":"00:03:49,000","end":"00:03:58,000","text":"When the person is a classmate or a friend, that image can quickly become embarrassing, harmful or even a form of bullying."},{"line":45,"start":"00:03:58,000","end":"00:04:04,000","text":"Children need to understand that making or sharing an AI image of someone else without their permission isn't just a harmless joke."},{"line":46,"start":"00:04:04,000","end":"00:04:13,000","text":"If the image is sexual, humiliating or meant to hurt someone, it can also lead to serious school or legal consequences."},{"line":47,"start":"00:04:13,000","end":"00:04:19,000","text":"When children see an image, their first reaction may still be, it's a picture, so it must be real."},{"line":48,"start":"00:04:19,000","end":"00:04:30,000","text":"That's right, and that's where it gets tricky. They might use a fake image to judge a person, understand an event or form an opinion without realising the image may be fabricated."},{"line":49,"start":"00:04:30,000","end":"00:04:33,000","text":"So what can parents actually do?"},{"line":50,"start":"00:04:33,000","end":"00:04:40,000","text":"Well, you could ask something like, where did this image come from? Could it have been made by AI?"},{"line":51,"start":"00:04:40,000","end":"00:04:44,000","text":"Or if the picture is not real, could the story be wrong too?"},{"line":52,"start":"00:04:44,000","end":"00:04:48,000","text":"These small questions help children pause before believing or sharing."},{"line":53,"start":"00:04:48,000","end":"00:04:55,000","text":"The third risk is more emotional. Children may start treating AI like someone that they can confide in."},{"line":54,"start":"00:04:55,000","end":"00:05:05,000","text":"And this can slip under the radar. When they're stressed or feeling low, they might type things like, I don't want to go to school, or am I not good enough?"},{"line":55,"start":"00:05:05,000","end":"00:05:17,000","text":"Those conversations may feel private, so children may also reveal names, school details, photos, locations or other sensitive information without realising it."},{"line":56,"start":"00:05:17,000","end":"00:05:23,000","text":"A simple rule is this. If you wouldn't share it publicly, don't type it into an AI tool."},{"line":57,"start":"00:05:23,000","end":"00:05:34,000","text":"AI can sound caring, but it does not know your child, cannot notice risk in a way a person can, and can't take responsibility for keeping them safe."},{"line":58,"start":"00:05:34,000","end":"00:05:42,000","text":"Sometimes it may agree with them or give advice that feels comforting, but it is not the same as being supported by a trusted adult."},{"line":59,"start":"00:05:42,000","end":"00:05:47,000","text":"Yeah, and because it sounds human, children can start thinking, it gets me."},{"line":60,"start":"00:05:47,000","end":"00:06:00,000","text":"That is the risk. In those moments, children may lean on tools that will not step in when help is really needed, instead of talking to parents, teachers, counselors or other trusted adults."},{"line":61,"start":"00:06:00,000","end":"00:06:09,000","text":"On the surface, it feels like someone is listening, but if the child is upset, unsafe or overwhelmed, a real person needs to be involved."},{"line":62,"start":"00:06:09,000","end":"00:06:12,000","text":"So, what can parents do?"},{"line":63,"start":"00:06:12,000","end":"00:06:20,000","text":"You might say, AI can help with ideas, but if something is really upsetting you, you need to reach out to a real person."},{"line":64,"start":"00:06:20,000","end":"00:06:30,000","text":"That message really matters. Over time, children learn that something can sound genuinely supportive without actually providing real support."},{"line":65,"start":"00:06:30,000","end":"00:06:34,000","text":"The good news is, you do not have to be a tech expert."},{"line":66,"start":"00:06:34,000","end":"00:06:45,000","text":"But it does help to stay curious. Know what tools your child uses, ask what they used them for, and talk about what information is safe to share."},{"line":67,"start":"00:06:45,000","end":"00:07:02,000","text":"So the main idea is, not block AI. It's use AI alongside your child. Help them notice the difference between useful ideas, information that needs checking, private information that should not be shared, and feelings that need real human support."},{"line":68,"start":"00:07:02,000","end":"00:07:10,000","text":"Next time, we'll look at what to do when something has already gone wrong online, and how parents can respond in that moment."},{"line":69,"start":"00:07:10,000","end":"00:07:11,000","text":"See you."},{"line":70,"start":"00:07:15,000","end":"00:07:20,000","text":"Thanks for watching."}]

title: Family Support After Online Risks
description: This episode explains how parents can respond after an online risk has happened. It focuses on reacting with empathy, understanding what occurred without blame, helping children learn from the experience, and knowing when to seek outside support.
transcript_text: [{"line":1,"start":"00:00:00,000","end":"00:00:15,000","text":"Welcome to 8 Minutes of Digital Parenting. I'm Emily."},{"line":2,"start":"00:00:15,000","end":"00:00:21,760","text":"Hi, I'm Jack. In the last episode we talked about generative AI and the hidden risks children"},{"line":3,"start":"00:00:21,760","end":"00:00:22,760","text":"can miss."},{"line":4,"start":"00:00:22,760","end":"00:00:28,880","text":"We're focused on three things. AI answers that sound real but may be wrong. Images that"},{"line":5,"start":"00:00:28,880","end":"00:00:34,120","text":"are hard to tell from real ones, and the emotional confusion that can happen when children"},{"line":6,"start":"00:00:34,120","end":"00:00:36,520","text":"treat AI like a friend."},{"line":7,"start":"00:00:36,520","end":"00:00:42,600","text":"The key message was that parents do not need to block AI completely. What helps is staying"},{"line":8,"start":"00:00:42,600","end":"00:00:48,000","text":"alongside children while they're learning to judge it, using it together, checking"},{"line":9,"start":"00:00:48,000","end":"00:00:51,840","text":"information and talking about what is safe to share."},{"line":10,"start":"00:00:51,840","end":"00:00:57,280","text":"Yes, that means reminding them not to believe everything they see, helping them double check"},{"line":11,"start":"00:00:57,280","end":"00:01:02,720","text":"information and helping them understand that AI is a tool. It cannot make judgements"},{"line":12,"start":"00:01:02,720","end":"00:01:07,120","text":"for them and it cannot take responsibility for their safety."},{"line":13,"start":"00:01:07,120","end":"00:01:13,280","text":"In this episode, we take the next step. What can parents do when an online risk has already"},{"line":14,"start":"00:01:13,280","end":"00:01:14,280","text":"happened?"},{"line":15,"start":"00:01:14,280","end":"00:01:21,040","text":"We'll walk through three steps. Regulate first, understand together and seek outside help"},{"line":16,"start":"00:01:21,040","end":"00:01:22,720","text":"when needed."},{"line":17,"start":"00:01:22,720","end":"00:01:28,440","text":"When something goes wrong online, maybe a child saw upsetting content, clicked on something"},{"line":18,"start":"00:01:28,440","end":"00:01:35,080","text":"misleading, shared something too quickly, or felt unsafe. By the time parents notice,"},{"line":19,"start":"00:01:35,080","end":"00:01:41,120","text":"the child may already feel overwhelmed, guilty or scared. Your first reaction can decide"},{"line":20,"start":"00:01:41,120","end":"00:01:43,320","text":"whether they keep on talking."},{"line":21,"start":"00:01:43,320","end":"00:01:48,040","text":"That's right. Many parents, when they first hear about it, might say, why did you click"},{"line":22,"start":"00:01:48,040","end":"00:01:50,640","text":"that or what were you thinking?"},{"line":23,"start":"00:01:50,640","end":"00:01:56,400","text":"It starts to a child that may not sound like concern. It can sound like blame."},{"line":24,"start":"00:01:56,400","end":"00:02:01,520","text":"Exactly, Jack. They may already be anxious or embarrassed and they may be worried that"},{"line":25,"start":"00:02:01,520","end":"00:02:04,520","text":"they will lose their device or get into trouble."},{"line":26,"start":"00:02:04,520","end":"00:02:09,920","text":"If your tone becomes sharp or the conversation feels like an interrogation, the child may"},{"line":27,"start":"00:02:09,920","end":"00:02:13,400","text":"hear one message, this is my fault."},{"line":28,"start":"00:02:13,400","end":"00:02:18,440","text":"So start with the emotion before the details. Help the child feel that you are on their"},{"line":29,"start":"00:02:18,440","end":"00:02:19,640","text":"side."},{"line":30,"start":"00:02:19,640","end":"00:02:25,800","text":"And that also means noticing your own reaction. Parents may feel shocked, frightened or angry"},{"line":31,"start":"00:02:25,800","end":"00:02:28,320","text":"when they hear what has happened."},{"line":32,"start":"00:02:28,320","end":"00:02:33,760","text":"Those feelings are understandable, but children often notice a parent's face, tone and body"},{"line":33,"start":"00:02:33,760","end":"00:02:36,480","text":"language before they take in the words."},{"line":34,"start":"00:02:36,480","end":"00:02:43,640","text":"So pause. Take a breath and try not to react immediately. You do not have to hide your concern,"},{"line":35,"start":"00:02:43,640","end":"00:02:49,160","text":"but you can show it without making the child feel blamed or responsible for your emotions."},{"line":36,"start":"00:02:49,160","end":"00:02:54,880","text":"That's right. A calm response does not mean that the situation is unimportant. It means"},{"line":37,"start":"00:02:54,880","end":"00:02:58,320","text":"creating enough safety for the child to keep talking."},{"line":38,"start":"00:02:58,320","end":"00:03:04,560","text":"You could say, did that scare you? You look really upset. Or do you want a minute before"},{"line":39,"start":"00:03:04,560","end":"00:03:06,480","text":"we talk about this?"},{"line":40,"start":"00:03:06,480","end":"00:03:11,680","text":"You do not have to fix everything right away. The first message is, you are not in trouble"},{"line":41,"start":"00:03:11,680","end":"00:03:15,080","text":"for telling me we'll work this through together."},{"line":42,"start":"00:03:15,080","end":"00:03:20,920","text":"The second step is to understand what happened without turning it into an interrogation."},{"line":43,"start":"00:03:20,920","end":"00:03:26,480","text":"Make the conversation feel like we're working this out together, not your being questioned."},{"line":44,"start":"00:03:26,480","end":"00:03:32,400","text":"You might say, I want to understand what happened so we can decide what to do next, or we can"},{"line":45,"start":"00:03:32,400","end":"00:03:34,400","text":"take this slowly."},{"line":46,"start":"00:03:34,400","end":"00:03:40,600","text":"Try to avoid a long chain of why questions, because they can sound like blame, even when"},{"line":47,"start":"00:03:40,600","end":"00:03:43,680","text":"parents are trying to understand."},{"line":48,"start":"00:03:43,680","end":"00:03:49,840","text":"Other questions are, what happened first? When did it start to feel uncomfortable? Or"},{"line":49,"start":"00:03:49,840","end":"00:03:52,680","text":"what are you most worried about now?"},{"line":50,"start":"00:03:52,680","end":"00:03:58,080","text":"These questions help parents understand the risk without making the child relive every"},{"line":51,"start":"00:03:58,080","end":"00:03:59,440","text":"detail."},{"line":52,"start":"00:03:59,440","end":"00:04:04,120","text":"And they give the child space to reflect, which is different from being punished."},{"line":53,"start":"00:04:04,120","end":"00:04:09,400","text":"While you're talking it through, focus on three things. What happened? What the child"},{"line":54,"start":"00:04:09,400","end":"00:04:14,000","text":"was thinking at the time, and what they are worried about now."},{"line":55,"start":"00:04:14,000","end":"00:04:19,080","text":"Many parents first instinct is to take the phone away, delete the app or switch everything"},{"line":56,"start":"00:04:19,080","end":"00:04:20,240","text":"off."},{"line":57,"start":"00:04:20,240","end":"00:04:26,000","text":"That reaction is understandable, but if the child feels, I told the truth, and then my"},{"line":58,"start":"00:04:26,000","end":"00:04:31,320","text":"phone was taken away, they may be less likely to come to you next time."},{"line":59,"start":"00:04:31,320","end":"00:04:36,200","text":"That's right. Many online risks are not just about the app. They can also be connected"},{"line":60,"start":"00:04:36,200","end":"00:04:42,800","text":"to how the child was feeling, stressed, lonely, curious, wanting approval, or acting quickly"},{"line":61,"start":"00:04:42,800","end":"00:04:44,800","text":"without thinking."},{"line":62,"start":"00:04:44,800","end":"00:04:52,560","text":"Instead of saying, that's it, you're not using this anymore. Slow the situation down, ask,"},{"line":63,"start":"00:04:52,560","end":"00:04:59,000","text":"how did you end up there? What made it so hard to stop and tell someone? And what might"},{"line":64,"start":"00:04:59,000","end":"00:05:01,440","text":"make it easier next time?"},{"line":65,"start":"00:05:01,440","end":"00:05:06,840","text":"Once you understand what happened, agree on one or two practical steps together, such"},{"line":66,"start":"00:05:06,840","end":"00:05:13,600","text":"as blocking an account, maybe changing a password, adjusting privacy settings, or reporting"},{"line":67,"start":"00:05:13,600","end":"00:05:15,320","text":"the content."},{"line":68,"start":"00:05:15,320","end":"00:05:21,800","text":"If the situation may need to be reported, save screenshots, usernames, messages, or"},{"line":69,"start":"00:05:21,800","end":"00:05:27,240","text":"links before deleting anything, as long as it is safe to do so."},{"line":70,"start":"00:05:27,240","end":"00:05:31,280","text":"The third step is seeking outside help when needed."},{"line":71,"start":"00:05:31,280","end":"00:05:34,840","text":"Parents sometimes may be worried that they are overreacting."},{"line":72,"start":"00:05:34,840","end":"00:05:39,880","text":"A practical guide is this. If the child is still not sleeping well, seems persistently"},{"line":73,"start":"00:05:39,880","end":"00:05:46,120","text":"anxious, keeps blaming themselves, avoids school, or says anything about self-harm, do"},{"line":74,"start":"00:05:46,120","end":"00:05:52,640","text":"not just wait it out, bring in support. Getting outside help does not mean something is wrong"},{"line":75,"start":"00:05:52,640","end":"00:05:57,440","text":"with your child. It means adding another supportive adult when the situation is too"},{"line":76,"start":"00:05:57,440","end":"00:06:00,280","text":"much for the family to carry alone."},{"line":77,"start":"00:06:00,280","end":"00:06:05,880","text":"In Australia, parents can use the e-safety commissioner for practical guides, reporting"},{"line":78,"start":"00:06:05,880","end":"00:06:10,400","text":"pathways, and support when they're not sure what to do next."},{"line":79,"start":"00:06:10,400","end":"00:06:16,880","text":"Schools, counsellors, GPs, help lines, and online safety reporting services can also help"},{"line":80,"start":"00:06:16,880","end":"00:06:19,520","text":"families decide on the next step."},{"line":81,"start":"00:06:19,520","end":"00:06:24,760","text":"If there is an immediate danger, or if a child may hurt themselves or someone else,"},{"line":82,"start":"00:06:24,760","end":"00:06:27,400","text":"seek urgent help straight away."},{"line":83,"start":"00:06:27,400","end":"00:06:33,080","text":"And when a child does come to you, a simple first response can make a big difference."},{"line":84,"start":"00:06:33,080","end":"00:06:38,000","text":"Thank you for telling me, you're not in trouble, we'll work this out together."},{"line":85,"start":"00:06:38,000","end":"00:06:42,840","text":"And do not assume that one conversation has finished the issue, check in again later that"},{"line":86,"start":"00:06:42,840","end":"00:06:47,440","text":"day or the next day, when the child may be ready to share more."},{"line":87,"start":"00:06:47,440","end":"00:06:52,640","text":"That's right, a simple question such as, how are you feeling about it now? Can show"},{"line":88,"start":"00:06:52,640","end":"00:06:57,520","text":"that your support continues after the immediate problem has been handled?"},{"line":89,"start":"00:06:57,520","end":"00:07:02,160","text":"It can also help to give your child a simple sentence that they can use if something goes"},{"line":90,"start":"00:07:02,160","end":"00:07:08,680","text":"wrong online, such as, I saw something that upset me, I need help."},{"line":91,"start":"00:07:08,680","end":"00:07:14,160","text":"We can't prevent every online risk, but we can make sure that when something happens,"},{"line":92,"start":"00:07:14,160","end":"00:07:18,040","text":"home still feels like a place children can come back to."},{"line":93,"start":"00:07:18,040","end":"00:07:24,040","text":"Real family support is not about being stricter or controlling more, it's about staying alongside"},{"line":94,"start":"00:07:24,040","end":"00:07:29,040","text":"your child and helping them work through the problem step by step."},{"line":95,"start":"00:07:29,040","end":"00:07:34,520","text":"Next time, we'll talk about a tough but important topic, cyberbullying."},{"line":96,"start":"00:07:34,520","end":"00:07:40,960","text":"If a child is being hurt or if they have hurt someone else, what can parents actually do?"},{"line":97,"start":"00:07:40,960","end":"00:07:42,560","text":"See you next time."},{"line":98,"start":"00:07:42,560","end":"00:07:43,560","text":"See you then!"}]

title: Cyberbullying: How Parents Can Respond
description: This episode explains how parents can respond to cyberbullying, whether their child is being targeted or has harmed others. It covers warning signs, listening without blame, saving evidence, seeking support, and helping children take responsibility and repair harm.
transcript_text: [{"line":1,"start":"00:00:00,000","end":"00:00:15,000","text":"Welcome to 8 minutes of digital parenting. I'm Emily."},{"line":2,"start":"00:00:15,000","end":"00:00:21,360","text":"Hi, I'm Jack. Today we're talking about cyberbullying, which can seriously affect children's"},{"line":3,"start":"00:00:21,360","end":"00:00:24,200","text":"well-being and sense of safety."},{"line":4,"start":"00:00:24,200","end":"00:00:29,040","text":"In this episode, we'll look at two sides of it. First, what parents can do if their child"},{"line":5,"start":"00:00:29,040","end":"00:00:33,960","text":"is being bullied online? And second, what to do if they realise their child might be"},{"line":6,"start":"00:00:33,960","end":"00:00:36,120","text":"hurting someone else?"},{"line":7,"start":"00:00:36,120","end":"00:00:42,280","text":"Let's start by being clear about what we mean. Cyberbullying is online behaviour that targets"},{"line":8,"start":"00:00:42,280","end":"00:00:49,800","text":"someone to make them feel distressed, humiliated, scared or hurt. It is often deliberate and"},{"line":9,"start":"00:00:49,800","end":"00:00:57,040","text":"repeated, but a single serious incident, like a threat, impersonation or sharing an intimate"},{"line":10,"start":"00:00:57,040","end":"00:01:00,200","text":"image, still needs adult action."},{"line":11,"start":"00:01:00,200","end":"00:01:06,640","text":"Exactly. And it can show up in many different ways. For example, spreading rumours or false"},{"line":12,"start":"00:01:06,640","end":"00:01:08,400","text":"information online."},{"line":13,"start":"00:01:08,400","end":"00:01:14,480","text":"Or making fun of someone, teasing them or trying to embarrass them, like posting or sharing"},{"line":14,"start":"00:01:14,480","end":"00:01:17,640","text":"photos or videos to humiliate them."},{"line":15,"start":"00:01:17,640","end":"00:01:23,360","text":"That's right. It can also be ongoing harassment such as repeated messages or comments that"},{"line":16,"start":"00:01:23,360","end":"00:01:25,560","text":"make someone feel targeted."},{"line":17,"start":"00:01:25,560","end":"00:01:31,320","text":"Or threatening someone, trying to get others to join in or in some cases, even encouraging"},{"line":18,"start":"00:01:31,320","end":"00:01:33,560","text":"someone to hurt themselves."},{"line":19,"start":"00:01:33,560","end":"00:01:40,720","text":"So yeah, cyberbullying can take many forms. And when you put it all together, it is serious."},{"line":20,"start":"00:01:40,720","end":"00:01:46,960","text":"In real life, many children will not simply say, I'm being bullied. More often, you might"},{"line":21,"start":"00:01:46,960","end":"00:01:52,360","text":"hear something like, I don't want to use that app anymore, or I'm not going on that"},{"line":22,"start":"00:01:52,360","end":"00:01:53,360","text":"app."},{"line":23,"start":"00:01:53,360","end":"00:01:58,800","text":"Or you might notice they suddenly mute a group chat, leave it, or stop opening it altogether."},{"line":24,"start":"00:01:58,800","end":"00:02:04,200","text":"Yeah. And behind that behaviour, something may not feel right for them. Sometimes it"},{"line":25,"start":"00:02:04,200","end":"00:02:08,640","text":"is discomfort. Sometimes it is real emotional harm."},{"line":26,"start":"00:02:08,640","end":"00:02:12,640","text":"So if you're trying to figure out what's going on, look at the bigger picture, not just"},{"line":27,"start":"00:02:12,640","end":"00:02:19,260","text":"the screen. You might notice their mood dropping, increased anxiety or irritability, trouble"},{"line":28,"start":"00:02:19,260","end":"00:02:22,840","text":"sleeping or lack of interest in going to school."},{"line":29,"start":"00:02:22,840","end":"00:02:26,160","text":"And they may just ask, does everyone hate me?"},{"line":30,"start":"00:02:26,160","end":"00:02:30,720","text":"And if you notice changes in what your child is saying about themselves or their life,"},{"line":31,"start":"00:02:30,720","end":"00:02:35,800","text":"especially if it sounds quite negative or hopeless, it's important to follow that up."},{"line":32,"start":"00:02:35,800","end":"00:02:41,160","text":"Yes, trust your instincts. It's always okay to seek support if something doesn't feel"},{"line":33,"start":"00:02:41,160","end":"00:02:42,160","text":"right."},{"line":34,"start":"00:02:42,160","end":"00:02:46,000","text":"So if you think something might be going on, what's the first step?"},{"line":35,"start":"00:02:46,000","end":"00:02:49,880","text":"Honestly, just listen and take it seriously."},{"line":36,"start":"00:02:49,880","end":"00:02:55,200","text":"Exactly. It's a big deal for a child to speak up. Instead of jumping in with, what"},{"line":37,"start":"00:02:55,200","end":"00:03:00,920","text":"did you do? Try. Thank you for telling me. We'll figure this out together."},{"line":38,"start":"00:03:00,920","end":"00:03:06,160","text":"Avoid comments like, you're overreacting because that can shut the conversation down"},{"line":39,"start":"00:03:06,160","end":"00:03:07,680","text":"straight away."},{"line":40,"start":"00:03:07,680","end":"00:03:13,480","text":"You could also say, this is not your fault and you do not have to deal with it alone."},{"line":41,"start":"00:03:13,480","end":"00:03:19,120","text":"Those words reduce shame and keep the door open for the next part of the conversation."},{"line":42,"start":"00:03:19,120","end":"00:03:24,800","text":"The second step is to keep safe evidence. This part matters because many parents want"},{"line":43,"start":"00:03:24,800","end":"00:03:28,840","text":"to delete messages immediately just to get them off the screen."},{"line":44,"start":"00:03:28,840","end":"00:03:33,840","text":"And that reaction is understandable. But once evidence is gone, it can be much harder to"},{"line":45,"start":"00:03:33,840","end":"00:03:35,760","text":"sort things out later."},{"line":46,"start":"00:03:35,760","end":"00:03:42,800","text":"For bullying messages, take screenshots, save chat records and note usernames, URLs, dates"},{"line":47,"start":"00:03:42,800","end":"00:03:49,840","text":"and times. If the content involves sexual images of a child or anything possibly illegal,"},{"line":48,"start":"00:03:49,840","end":"00:03:56,880","text":"do not save, forward or share it. Record platform details where safe and seek official reporting"},{"line":49,"start":"00:03:56,880","end":"00:03:58,360","text":"advice."},{"line":50,"start":"00:03:58,360","end":"00:04:03,560","text":"The third step is to deal with the platform together. Don't leave your child to handle"},{"line":51,"start":"00:04:03,560","end":"00:04:10,480","text":"it alone. You can report the content, block the account and change privacy settings together."},{"line":52,"start":"00:04:10,480","end":"00:04:15,960","text":"If it keeps happening, involves threats or the platform does not do enough, reach out"},{"line":53,"start":"00:04:15,960","end":"00:04:22,360","text":"for extra help such as the school or to the e-safety website in Australia. You can find"},{"line":54,"start":"00:04:22,360","end":"00:04:29,120","text":"the details for these support services in the podcast Q&A page. There is help out there."},{"line":55,"start":"00:04:29,120","end":"00:04:33,760","text":"That's right. At this point, many parents might think, right, that's it. I'm taking"},{"line":56,"start":"00:04:33,760","end":"00:04:37,880","text":"the phone or no more internet, no more social media."},{"line":57,"start":"00:04:37,880","end":"00:04:43,480","text":"That urge is understandable. Parents want the harm to stop immediately. But if your"},{"line":58,"start":"00:04:43,480","end":"00:04:49,160","text":"child feels they were punished for telling you, they may not come to you next time."},{"line":59,"start":"00:04:49,160","end":"00:04:53,680","text":"Taking the device away can also cut them off from supportive friends, school messages"},{"line":60,"start":"00:04:53,680","end":"00:04:56,080","text":"or ways to get help."},{"line":61,"start":"00:04:56,080","end":"00:05:01,280","text":"Instead, talk through the options together so that your child knows that you are trying"},{"line":62,"start":"00:05:01,280","end":"00:05:04,360","text":"to protect them, not punish them."},{"line":63,"start":"00:05:04,360","end":"00:05:09,560","text":"And at the end of the day, children need to hear this clearly. This is not your fault."},{"line":64,"start":"00:05:09,560","end":"00:05:13,200","text":"You did not cause it and you are not on your own."},{"line":65,"start":"00:05:13,200","end":"00:05:18,240","text":"Now there is another side to this that many parents find harder to face. Sometimes the"},{"line":66,"start":"00:05:18,240","end":"00:05:23,520","text":"issue is not that a child is being hurt. It is that they might be the one hurting somebody"},{"line":67,"start":"00:05:23,520","end":"00:05:24,520","text":"else."},{"line":68,"start":"00:05:24,520","end":"00:05:30,360","text":"Yeah. If you realise a complaint has come in, the messages came from your child or someone"},{"line":69,"start":"00:05:30,360","end":"00:05:34,720","text":"else has been affected by what they said or did. What do you do then?"},{"line":70,"start":"00:05:34,720","end":"00:05:39,560","text":"One thing that is important to remember is that being involved in cyberbullying does"},{"line":71,"start":"00:05:39,560","end":"00:05:44,160","text":"not automatically mean that your child is a bad kid."},{"line":72,"start":"00:05:44,160","end":"00:05:49,920","text":"That's right. It may involve peer pressure, acting in the moment, wanting to fit in or"},{"line":73,"start":"00:05:49,920","end":"00:05:51,680","text":"unclear boundaries."},{"line":74,"start":"00:05:51,680","end":"00:05:54,360","text":"But it still needs a serious response."},{"line":75,"start":"00:05:54,360","end":"00:05:56,360","text":"It's not something to brush off."},{"line":76,"start":"00:05:56,360","end":"00:06:02,160","text":"Exactly. This is a moment to step in, calmly, clearly and firmly."},{"line":77,"start":"00:06:02,160","end":"00:06:06,920","text":"So how might parents spot that their child is bullying others?"},{"line":78,"start":"00:06:06,920","end":"00:06:11,320","text":"Sometimes it is obvious. You may see the message yourself or hear from the school or"},{"line":79,"start":"00:06:11,320","end":"00:06:12,880","text":"another parent."},{"line":80,"start":"00:06:12,880","end":"00:06:17,960","text":"Sometimes it's more subtle.
